data.narrative:
Skapion is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $36M to date, led by founder Ido Bar-On (ex-XTEND) alongside military and aerospace veterans including Brig. Gen. (Res.) Pini Yungman (ex-Rafael, Iron Dome program). The peer universe comprises 10 comparables—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $36M raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, implies $90M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The divergence reflects substantial variance in capital deployment and market positioning within the cohort.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $76M to $805M, with a median of $395M. The wide band reflects uncertainty in Skapion's technical differentiation relative to the peer set and the nascent stage of the company. Key unknowns include product validation timelines, customer traction, and the company's specific positioning within defense subsectors.
